summary: Release and Health failed on main for days (every Release since 2026-11-09, every hourly Health) and nobody was told: only Verify Nightly filed an issue, and no Grafana alert watched CI. Release and Health now end with a verdict job, and all three workflows keep one open "<Workflow> is failing on main" issue and record ci.workflow.result, whose generated Grafana alert pages until the workflow is green on main.
